new.md: Creates a new calendar, with the current date being selected.

doc.brief: Displays a Gregorian calendar, one month at a time.
doc.md:
Displays a Gregorian calendar, one month at a time.

A `GtkCalendar` can be created with [`Calendar.new()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Calendar#constructor:new).

The selected date can be retrieved from a `GtkCalendar` using
[`Calendar.get_date()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Calendar#method:get_date).
It can be altered with [`Calendar.set_date()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Calendar#method:set_date).

To place a visual marker on a particular day, use
[`Calendar.mark_day()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Calendar#method:mark_day) and to remove the marker,
[`Calendar.unmark_day()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Calendar#method:unmark_day). Alternative, all
marks can be cleared with [`Calendar.clear_marks()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Calendar#method:clear_marks).

Users should be aware that, although the Gregorian calendar is the
legal calendar in most countries, it was adopted progressively
between 1582 and 1929. Display before these dates is likely to be
historically incorrect.

# Shortcuts and Gestures

`GtkCalendar` supports the following gestures:

- Scrolling up or down will switch to the previous or next month.
- Date strings can be dropped for setting the current day.

# CSS nodes

```
calendar.view
├── header
│   ├── button
│   ├── stack.month
│   ├── button
│   ├── button
│   ├── label.year
│   ╰── button
╰── grid
    ╰── label[.day-name][.week-number][.day-number][.other-month][.today]
```

`GtkCalendar` has a main node with name calendar. It contains a subnode
called header containing the widgets for switching between years and months.

The grid subnode contains all day labels, including week numbers on the left
(marked with the .week-number css class) and day names on top (marked with the
.day-name css class).

Day labels that belong to the previous or next month get the .other-month
style class. The label of the current day get the .today style class.

Marked day labels get the :selected state assigned.

set_day.brief: Sets the day for the selected date.
set_day.md:
Sets the day for the selected date.

The new date must be valid. For example, setting the day to 31 when the
month is February will fail.

set_month.brief: Sets the month for the selected date.
set_month.md:
Sets the month for the selected date.

The new date must be valid. For example, setting the month to 1 (February)
when the day is 31 will fail.

set_show_heading.brief: Sets whether the calendar should show a heading.
set_show_heading.md:
Sets whether the calendar should show a heading.

The heading contains the current year and month as well as
buttons for changing both.

set_year.brief: Sets the year for the selected date.
set_year.md:
Sets the year for the selected date.

The new date must be valid. For example, setting the year to 2023 when the
date is February 29 will fail.
